jobs.description:
Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We’re looking for a Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager to design, launch, and improve digital customer journeys at scale. You’ll turn customer and product signals into timely, useful programs that help customers move from trial through activation, adoption, and ongoing value. This is a hands-on, program-focused role for someone who enjoys combining thoughtful communication, data, experimentation, and emerging technology.

Reporting into the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success, this role is based remotely in North America, with hiring locations in the United States or Canada.

How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

What we're looking for:

• Bring experience in Digital Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Growth Operations, Customer Success Operations, or Product-led Growth within a Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

• Have owned or significantly contributed to lifecycle or digital customer programs with measurable impact.

• Write clear, engaging customer-facing communications and adapt messaging for different audiences and customer needs.

• Interpret customer and product usage data, identify patterns, and turn insights into practical campaign and journey improvements.

• Work effectively across Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Data, Operations, and Content teams while navigating changing priorities and building new programs from the ground up.


Bonus points for:
• Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) tools to accelerate campaign development, analysis, experimentation, or content creation.

• Experience with 1Password, cybersecurity, or a similar technology product.

What you can expect:

• Design, launch, and continuously improve digital customer journeys across onboarding, activation, adoption, expansion, and renewal.

• Develop targeted campaigns that help customers move from trial to meaningful product adoption and guide them toward the right next step.

• Draft, edit, and optimize customer-facing email campaigns, connecting them with education resources and other digital experiences.

• Use customer signals, milestones, and behaviors to identify moments of friction or opportunity and create timely interventions.

• Monitor campaign performance through metrics such as engagement, activation, product usage, retention, and expansion; use experimentation and cohort analysis to improve results.

• Partner with Data and Analytics teams to support dashboards and reporting, then use those insights to make informed recommendations.

• Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Content partners to keep programs accurate, useful, and aligned with the customer journey.

• Use tools such as Gainsight, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and AI solutions to increase campaign quality, testing speed, and operational efficiency.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building in an evolving environment, can work independently through ambiguity, and is motivated by creating scalable customer experiences that help more people get value from 1Password.


USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $96,000 USD and $134,000 USD. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $88,000 CAD and $123,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.
How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.
Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.
For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:
Health and wellbeing
Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
Competitive health benefits
Generous PTO policy
Growth and future
RSU program for most employees
Retirement matching program
Free 1Password account
Community
Paid volunteer days
Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. jobs.title: AI Video Creator & Editor
jobs.description:
AI Video Creator & Editor

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Video Creator & Editor based in United Kingdom.

This role combines AI video generation and hands-on editing to create high-performing direct-response advertising for Meta and TikTok.
You will own creatives end to end, from interpreting briefs and generating AI footage to editing polished, launch-ready ads.
The position focuses on UGC-style talking-head content, product scenes, b-roll, hooks, variations, and conversion-driven storytelling.
You will work closely with Creative Strategists and the Paid Social team to turn concepts and performance insights into compelling new assets.
Success means consistently delivering high-quality, on-brief creatives at volume while keeping revisions low and continuously improving what performs.
You will join a growing remote video team and have access to AI tools, established workflows, and real campaign environments in which to develop your skills.
The role is fully remote, full-time, and follows UK working hours.


Accountabilities
  • Generate AI video assets for Meta and TikTok advertising, including UGC-style talking-head clips, product scenes, b-roll, and complete concept videos.
  • Develop and refine prompts, reference images, and generation settings while maintaining a reusable library of effective prompts and workflows.
  • Edit high-volume direct-response ads by combining AI-generated footage with scripts, raw footage, UGC, and approved product assets.
  • Create compelling first-second hooks, rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, product demonstrations, offers, and clear calls to action.
  • Produce multiple variations of successful concepts by testing different hooks, scenes, characters, openings, pacing, and visual treatments.
  • Maintain visual consistency across characters, products, and brand assets while quality-checking generated content for realistic motion, readable text, accurate product representation, and other AI-generation issues.
  • Add motion graphics using After Effects or an equivalent tool and ensure creatives meet platform and brand requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Strategists to execute briefs accurately, respond quickly to feedback, and contribute new angles, hooks, and formats suited to AI generation.
  • Keep project files, assets, and feedback organized using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar collaboration and asset-management tools.
  • Stay current with evolving AI video models and creative technologies, testing new tools and incorporating effective workflows into production.
  • Maintain reliable turnaround times and a high-quality output while contributing to creative testing, learning, and scalable advertising concepts.

    • Requirements:

    • Bring 1–3 years of experience in creative or video production, including e-commerce or direct-response paid-social editing, with a portfolio demonstrating both self-edited conversion-focused ads and AI-generated video work.
    • Have hands-on experience with AI video-generation tools such as Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Sora, Runway, or similar platforms, with strong prompting and iteration skills.
    • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut, together with After Effects or equivalent motion-graphics capabilities.
    • Be comfortable using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar tools for organized asset management, collaboration, and feedback.
    • Understand hook-first, direct-response editing for Meta and TikTok, including rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, visual proof, product demonstrations, offers, CTAs, and testable creative variations.
    • Have a strong visual eye and the ability to distinguish AI-generated footage that feels authentic from content that appears artificial or unrealistic.
    • Be able to maintain high output without sacrificing quality, respond quickly to feedback, and work accurately under pressure.
    • Demonstrate creativity, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and a thoughtful, methodical approach to production.
    • Have strong written and spoken English, proactive communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a remote creative team.
    • Be available for a full-time, exclusive commitment without other clients or freelance work alongside the role.
    • Experience with AI image-generation tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, or Flux, AI voice tools such as ElevenLabs, winning or scaled advertising campaigns, visually driven DTC categories, motion design, compositing, 3D, VFX, or sound design is considered a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation discussed individually based on experience and location.
      • Fully remote, full-time work following UK working hours.
      • Access to AI video-generation tools and approved creative workflows.
      • Opportunities to develop AI generation and video-editing skills through real advertising campaigns.
      • Regular structured meetings and scheduled feedback sessions with the creative team.

jobs.title: Sr. Account Manager
jobs.description:
Sr. Account Manager

Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Account Manager at Help Scout, you'll take true end-to-end ownership of a portfolio of 130–150 accounts. building trusted relationships with the key stakeholders who rely on Help Scout every day. You’ll bring strong commercial judgment to every stage of the customer lifecycle, balancing customer needs, long-term value, and Help Scout’s business goals as you lead renewals and identify opportunities for revenue growth.

You'll help them reach their support goals, keep their experience smooth and impactful, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Whether it's an optimization review, a strategic check-in, or a well-timed follow-up, you'll be the kind of partner they can count on — and the kind of teammate who sees around corners before problems arise.

You'll also be their internal advocate, bringing what you learn in customer conversations to help us build a better product, strengthen onboarding, and shape how we grow as a team. If you're energized by full ownership, love finding efficiencies (including through AI-powered tools), and take pride in the kind of disciplined follow-through that builds long-term trust, you'll thrive here.

  • Own a high-volume portfolio of 130–150 accounts end-to-end. From onboarding handoff through renewal and expansion, you’ll be accountable for outcomes at every stage.

  • Forecast and track your own revenue goals. You’ll identify risks and opportunities in each account and share clear, proactive signals with finance and leadership teams.

  • Own the full commercial process for renewals and expansions. You’ll lead discovery, develop thoughtful proposals, navigate pricing and contract conversations, coordinate procurement, and move opportunities through to close.

  • Exercise sound commercial judgment. You’ll use customer goals, product usage, account history, and business value to shape recommendations that support both the customer relationship and Help Scout’s growth.

  • Drive adoption and engagement through regular calls, optimization reviews, and QBRs, surfacing underused features and identifying paths to stronger product alignment.

  • Partner closely with Product and cross-functional teams, bringing the voice of the customer into go-to-market meetings, roadmap discussions, and company-wide decisions.

  • Maintain ownership across cross-functional work. You’ll bring in the right internal partners when needed while continuing to coordinate next steps, communicate with the customer, and ensure the work reaches a clear outcome.

  • Design and continuously improve your own workflows. You have freedom and support here leverage AI tools to create efficiencies and ensure nothing gets dropped across a large, active book of business.

  • Act as the connective tissue between customers and internal teams. You’ll think ahead, anticipate what’s coming, and ensure clear communication, seamless coordination, and consistent follow-through..

About You

  • You're a sales-forward Account Manager with 5+ years of quota-carrying experience in SaaS, consistently driving renewals, expansions, and upsells with strategic accounts.

  • You have strong commercial judgment. You’re comfortable evaluating customer needs, usage, business value, and account context to develop thoughtful proposals and guide productive pricing and renewal conversations.

  • You're comfortable owning a book of 130–150 accounts and thrive in high-volume environments — you stay organized, keep your pipeline clean, and take pride in the fact that nothing slips through.

  • You’re comfortable owning the full renewal and expansion process. You can lead discovery, present recommendations, negotiate confidently, coordinate internal approvals, and guide an opportunity through to close.

  • You think and act like a true owner. You proactively identify risks and opportunities, develop a clear plan, and communicate early enough for the team to take meaningful action.

  • You're a strong cross-functional partner. You know how to work alongside Product, Marketing, and other teams — not just escalate to them — and you bring the customer perspective in a way that influences decisions.

  • You’re really into the numbers. You're comfortable building and maintaining your own revenue projections, and you communicate risks and opportunities clearly to leadership without needing hand-holding.

  • You’re excited about how AI can transform your work. You look for ways to design smarter processes, reduce manual overhead, and spend your time where it matters most.

  • You have a consultative, value-based approach that helps customers connect their goals to the best of what Help Scout offers — and you're excited to help shape a growing team.

  • Technical aptitude. You're comfortable learning and navigating complex software. You pick up new tools and platforms quickly.

About the Process

  1. Recruiter Chat - You'll meet with Erika on the Recruiting team to chat through compensation, benefits, timeline, and company culture.

  2. Value add - You'll meet with Sewar, Director of Account Management, to talk more about the role and your experience in more detail.

  3. Project - We’ll give you a take-home project (we’ll pay for your time), then you’ll share it back to the team.

  4. Final Chat - You’ll chat with another 1-2 people on the team, who will vary depending on what else we’d like to learn about you.

  5. References - We’ll ask you for three references. Ideally, we’d like two of them to be managers, but we can be flexible.

Compensation

Each role at Help Scout has a pay range aligned to our salary formula and based on national market data. We take a competency-based approach and pay is based on the level and band of your role. We assess leveling during the hiring process for new teammates, during our bi-annual performance review cycles, and when a teammate’s role changes.

Base salary: $109K

OTE: $156K

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

Full-Time USA

jobs.title: Family Advocacy Intervention Specialist (FAIS)
jobs.company: The Copper River Family of Companies
jobs.description:
Family Advocacy Intervention Specialist (FAIS)

Coho Integrated Solutions is seeking a qualified Family Advocacy Intervention Specialist (FAIS) to support the Department of the Air Force Family Advocacy Program in Lakenheath, Suffolk, United Kingdom. The FAIS serves as a clinical provider and prevention specialist responsible for supporting intervention and secondary prevention efforts related to domestic abuse, child maltreatment, problematic sexual behavior in children and youth, and family wellness.

The FAIS may augment the services of the Family Advocacy Treatment Manager and is expected to perform the applicable clinical and prevention responsibilities associated with the FATM role.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Provide clinical intervention, counseling, assessment, and case management services to individuals, couples, families, and groups.
  • Support assessment and treatment of domestic abuse and child maltreatment cases.
  • Conduct psychosocial, safety, risk, needs, and other clinical assessments as appropriate.
  • Develop and monitor individualized treatment and safety plans.
  • Provide psychotherapy, psychoeducation, crisis intervention, advocacy, and clinical casework.
  • Provide secondary prevention services addressing domestic abuse, child maltreatment, and problematic sexual behavior in children and youth.
  • Deliver New Leader Orientation and annual training to commanders, first sergeants, organizational leadership, and key agencies.
  • Serve as a prevention facilitator and installation FAP representative for the Community Action Team and other community organizations.
  • Develop, promote, and implement FAP prevention programs under the direction and approval of the FAP Manager.
  • Develop social marketing and outreach strategies to increase awareness of family maltreatment prevention resources.
  • Identify family violence trends and collaborate with FAP personnel and community organizations to target prevention efforts.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of prevention activities and support required program reporting.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Clearance:
    • Must be eligible for and maintain required privileging within the Military Treatment Facility
    • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust determination in accordance with applicable contract and government requirements
  • Education, Licensure, and Certifications:
    • Must be a U.S.-licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
      • LCSW: Master's degree from a CSWE-accredited school
      • LMFT: Master's degree from a COAMFTE-accredited Marriage and Family Therapy program, or an appropriately qualifying allied mental health degree with equivalent Marriage and Family Therapy study
    • Must maintain the applicable unrestricted professional license
    • Must meet all applicable clinical privileging requirements
    • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification
  • Required Experience:
    • LCSW: Two years of post-MSW experience within the last three years in a clinical/treatment setting
    • LMFT: Two years of experience within the last two years as a marriage and family counselor
    • Two years of full-time post-master's clinical counseling experience serving individuals who are abusive or abused
    • Demonstrated group therapy facilitation or co-leadership experience
    • Experience working with children, families, groups, professionals, and community agencies
  • Physical Requirements:
    • Ability to travel within the assigned area for outreach, prevention, and community activities
    • Ability to work in clinical, office, community, and other approved environments
  • Work Environment:
    • Work is performed in clinical, office, community, and outreach settings and may involve interaction with individuals and families experiencing sensitive or challenging circumstances

About Copper River & The Native Village of Eyak:

Owned by the Native Village of Eyak (NVE), a federally recognized Alaska Native Tribe, the Copper River Family of Companies are a collection of entities that deliver a complementary set of solutions and services to support the diverse missions and requirements of our clients. Proud participants of the Small Business Administration's (SBA) 8(a) Business Development Program since 2006, our companies consist of both current and graduation SBA 8(a) entities. It is our collective purpose to support the Tribe and diversify the NVE's ability to facilitate economic advancement.

The income generated from our companies helps the Native Village of Eyak fund health and social services, economic development, natural resource/environmental education, jobs, job training, and other benefits to the NVE in a manner that is consistent with Alaskan Native cultural values and traditions.

Copper River's Culture

The Copper River Family of Companies has a positive, supportive, and thriving culture. At the foundation of our culture is a focus on collaboration. No matter your role or which operating company you work for, we are ONE TEAM working toward the same goals for our customers and for our collective owner- The Native Village of Eyak. How we treat each other is just as important as the work we deliver.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care
  • Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan
  • Retirement 401(k) with employer match
  • Open leave policy and paid holidays
  • Additional benefits including tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more! 

Note: Benefits are offered based on employment classification and applicable contract requirements. Eligibility may vary by position.

Disclaimer:

The Copper River Family of Companies provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Campaign Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Campaign Marketing Manager

Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Campaign Marketing Manager (12 Month FTC)

Location: London, United Kingdom (3 days a week from Client Canary Wharf offices)

Our client has a hybrid working experience that blends the positives of working alongside colleagues at onsite locations, together with working from home. That means you'll work at an onsite location on fixed, 'anchor', days of the week, for a minimum of three days a week.  For this role, you could work in any of the offices, including Canary Wharf, Northampton, Glasgow or Cardiff.  

About the role:
We're looking for an experienced Campaign Marketing Manager to join our client team on a 12-month fixed-term contract, working directly within their B2C Performance team across a range of multi-channel campaigns and projects.

You'll hit the ground running in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment — leading and delivering multi-variant marketing comms across paid and owned digital channels. From mining customer and performance insights to delivering final assets and reviewing results, you'll own the process end to end.

You're a highly collaborative self-starter, skilled at juggling multiple projects and managing senior stakeholders in regulated environments. Experience across paid and owned channels — including video, display, social, email, and OOH — is essential. A background in Financial Services is a plus; experience in telecoms, utilities, or similarly regulated industries is equally welcome.

What you will be doing: 

  • Creating and producing brilliantly effective campaigns that differentiate the client from their competitors, through superior targeting, communication strategy, tech innovation & creative quality

  • Working collaboratively with the wider Marketing Centre of Excellence to ensure communications are on product message, customer focused, developed in line with brand guidelines, aligned to brand values, adhere to regulatory requirements and developed in line with relevant governance frameworks

  • Effectively managing budgets to maximise return on investment and drive commercial performance, as measured by solutions growth and cost per acquisition

  • Keeping campaigns on time and to plan, regardless of the curved balls that you might experience along the way

  • Working collaboratively with business stakeholders to develop clear roadmaps and testing designs

  • Managing relationships with the UK Digital, Product & Marketing teams, as well as various external agency partners

  • Leading the campaign delivery lifecycle – from ideation/discovery, through planning & prioritization, to solution design and in-channel execution

  • Reporting on campaign performance and testing outcomes

  • Being genuinely collaborative, inside and outside the team, to help make the Performance Marketing team a great place to work

  • Fostering strong and meaningful relationships with key stakeholders by maintaining a regular dialogue, keeping them informed on all key milestones and outcomes, with clear recommendations to drive performance uplift

  • Raising any issues in a timely and rational manner, ensuring the highest standards of control & governance

  • Being a self-starter, able to bring proactive opportunities and solutions to key stakeholders, as opposed to waiting for direction

  • Sharing experience from a customer-driven organisation with a customer first mindset

  • Taking ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you do

  • Ensuring high levels of accuracy across all comms and ensuring that QA is never compromised

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Being confident, smart, enthusiastic and proactive with great comms skills, both written and verbal

  • Being a self-starter with strong and positive energy; someone who will work collaboratively with everyone who'll support them in delivering campaigns

  • Having strong juggling and prioritisation skills acquired in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment, with the ability to work across multiple projects at any given time

  • Demonstrating extensive Digital Marketing experience – particularly across paid media channels and an understanding of best practice of using these channels individually and as a broader media strategy

  • Understanding digital marketing end to end delivery, from planning, scheduling & prioritising to customer targeting, channel management, effective promotion of products and services, personalisation, implementation and governance

  • Having the ability to hit objectives and deadlines, plan well and deliver to that plan

  • Showing the resilience to face into challenge and change, looking for feedback and insight from everything around them

  • Demonstrating a track record of delivering results in competitive markets; prioritising opportunities and activity to have the greatest commercial impact

  • Having the ability to uncover meaningful customer, market and performance insights, and translate them into effective marketing strategies and campaigns that drive measurable outcomes

  • Embodying the values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship

GTM Finance, Director

Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

  • Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
  • Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
  • Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on GTM Finance, Director to serve as our first GTM finance business partner at SmithRx. Partnering closely with Sales and Marketing (S&M) leadership, this builder will shape the financial foundation of our go-to-market engine. We are looking for an individual who can scale a business-oriented finance function from the ground up. Reporting to the Senior Director, Strategic Finance, this role will own financial planning, forecasting, and performance analysis across the GTM organization. You will play a critical role in driving GTM strategy, delivering actionable insights, and ensuring alignment between growth investments and financial outcomes.

What you will do:

  • Build deep partnerships with Sales and Marketing (S&M) leadership by providing strategic decision support across all areas of investment, delivering high-level financial results, and identifying emerging market trends.
  • Own and continuously improve forecasting models for members and revenue, ensuring alignment with pipeline, targets and long-range planning.
  • Own and evolve GTM KPIs and ROI frameworks (CAC, LTV, Payback) to guide decision making that aligns with the Company’s long-term objectives.
  • Partner with GTM teams on pricing strategy and proposals, developing robust P&L models for new customers and contracts.
  • Own the monthly forecasts, executive-level variance analysis, annual planning, and spend management for the S&M organization.
  • Partner with Sales, Rev Ops and HR to align headcount planning, capacity models, and incentive structures including commission modeling and quota development.
  • Stand up the systems, tooling, and frameworks needed to influence the business, including automation, reporting, and operational rhythms.

What you will bring to SmithRx:

  • 8+ years of experience in FP&A, GTM Finance, Strategic Finance, or related fields, preferably in a high-growth environment.
  • Proven experience supporting Sales or Marketing leadership, with strong understanding of revenue models and GTM unit economics.
  • Experience in healthcare or health tech is preferred.
  • Capable of managing executive relationships, high-stakes deliverables, and complex expectations with your business partners.
  • Expert in financial modeling and quantitative analysis who thrives on solving unstructured problems and influencing senior business partners.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Director of Product Marketing

Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Director, Product Marketing

We're looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own how Help Scout tells its story in a crowded, fast-growing market – shaping the positioning, narrative, and go-to-market strategy that define how customers, prospects, and the industry understand our platform.

It's an exciting time to be here. With a new vision and an AI-driven vision, we’ll be shipping more products faster to ensure we can quickly meet the changing needs of the market. You'll set the strategy for how we position that pace of innovation, build the frameworks that help the whole company talk about it credibly, and make sure our AI-driven product investments land as real value in the market not just feature noise. You'll report to the VP of Marketing, leading our product marketing function, and will manage our Lead Product Marketing Manager.

Please note: This role is only open to US-based applicants.

About the role

  • Own product marketing strategy. Set and execute the quarterly and long-term strategy for how Help Scout positions its product and platform, informed by market trends, competitive analytics, and where the company is headed.

  • Build and scale the product marketing function. Manage and partner with our Lead Product Marketing Manager, setting priorities, coaching on craft, and creating room for them to grow into owning larger initiatives. You'll help build the team's roadmap for headcount and capability over the next 12-18 months.

  • Enable the whole company. Ensure sales, support, and teammates across Help Scout have what they need to understand and clearly articulate the value of what we ship. You'll build the frameworks and enable the company to talk about our products in a way that ultimately leads to new revenue and expansion.

  • Shape competitive intelligence at a strategic level. Go beyond synthesizing competitive research by turning it into a point of view on where the market is heading and how Help Scout should move to win, and make sure that point of view shapes product-led growth, direct and indirect sales, and expansion.

  • Own major product launches and seasonal release events end-to-end. Set the strategy and narrative arc for product release events and other major launches, coordinating across Sales, Product, Support, and Marketing to land them with impact.

  • Represent Help Scout's product story externally. Use guest posts, podcasts, social, and other channels to build the company's external visibility and reputation as a category leader, both for the platform and for how we're building it.

About you

  • You have significant experience in product marketing for a B2B SaaS product or AI platform, with a track record of owning strategy, not just executing campaigns.

  • You're an expert in every core discipline of product marketing: positioning, messaging, buyer personas/ICP, sales enablement, and launches, and you can identify which high-value activities matter most for the business right now.

  • You've managed people before, and know how to coach someone on craft, give them room to own real work, and help them grow into more senior responsibility.

  • You have a point of view on positioning AI-powered products credibly, and ideally have direct experience marketing AI features or products.

  • You use AI tools daily to improve your own output and your team's, and you can point to specific examples where AI changed the speed, quality, or scale of what you or your team delivered.

  • You're a storyteller at heart. You write strong narratives that make complex products feel simple, human, and memorable, and you know how to communicate and build relationships across a remote, async environment.

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

Senior Sales Engineer

Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.

The Senior Sales Engineer (SSE) is a technical sales support position responsible for arranging pre-sales engagement to current and prospective clients. The position requires a strong technical leader who understands how their decisions impact and influence the customer’s bottom line while driving revenue for Commvault.

The SSE must be seen as a trusted advisor at all levels within an account (C-Suite, technical partners, etc.), as well as be a team leader, mentor, guide, and chip into overall success of Commvault. The SSE drives or supports complicated sales opportunities by translating business requirements into solution technical requirements; coordinating technical expertise; sizing, defining delivery and deployment approach, timeline, and required resources; coordinating demonstrations and proof-of-concept; and supporting internal deal acceptance.

**Candidate must be located in Washington or Oregon to be considered for this position**

What you’ll do…

  • Work as part of the account team to formulate and produce territory plans, account strategies, and sales plans including engaging specialist resources for accounts determined by the Sales and SE Manager. SSE will as well develop new opportunities within the assigned territory.
  • Anticipate technology trends and successfully build positive relationships with external partners and internal departments (sales, support, business units, product management, marketing, development), as appropriate, to ensure success during sales campaigns and/or to ensure the customer experience is extremely positive.
  • Adopt calling on senior level IT leadership often without account executive present at the same time and engage with the customer to qualify and understand key technical, financial, operational, and business issues that can be addressed with anyone or all of Commvault products.
  • Proactive in establishing relationships with technical decision makers within end-user accounts and driving detailed, executable Technical Account Plans for all focus targets and current customers using Commvault Target Account Selling methodology for both open opportunities and ongoing customer happiness.
  • Distill the pre-sales discovery into a concise message, outlining the salient technical, business, operational, and financial inefficiencies/challenges that Commvault addresses with its products.
  • Collaborate with the creation and presentation of a case to any and all business sponsors (i.e., C-level executives, technical partners, etc.) in support of the Commvault solution.
  • Propose and professionally demonstrate Commvault products through the use of presentations, existing customer solutions, white board, demo’s, pilots, "proof-of-concepts", etc.
  • Actively participate in all Sales and regional meetings, QBRs, making valuable contributions and technical leadership on all topics (field marketing, qualifying, etc.).
  • Provide technical expertise and enablement support for the channel and alliance partners as needed.
  • Continuously develop and maintain technical and market expertise through training, certifications, conferences, etc.
  • Keep senior management and relevant internal groups well informed of key issues and changes which may impact encouraged business results through business reviews and Salesforce.com documentation.
  • Assist with potential product or process improvements to appropriate internal groups and participate where vital in formulating innovative solutions.

Who you are…

  • 5+ years in the software or storage industry; 3+ years of proven experience serving in a pre-sales sales engineer role.
  • Demonstrates solid experience delivering, presenting, selling, supporting assigned SLED Clients and/or territories.
  • Provides strong competitive knowledge
  • Proven strong experience selling, conducting Proof of Concept, architecting data management solutions (backup and recovery, data migration, replication, compliance, SRM, etc.).
  • Work in a rapid growth environment where priorities, roles and responsibilities are continuously updated to meet market and customer demands.
  • Experienced in participating in and establishing teams of specialists to support customers and sales cycles to successful outcomes.
  • Basic knowledge with common Software licensing practices (cloud, perpetual, term, maintenance)
  • Specialized knowledge/skills and demonstrated proficiency with at least one major open systems operating system, hypervisor or cloud.
  • Enterprise application exposure or knowledge of SAP, Oracle, Exchange, db2, SharePoint, etc.
  • Solid knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as storage, servers, networking, cloud, hyper-convergence, etc.
  • Requires strong consultative selling skills which pair product expertise with business and industry foresight. Solid experience with case creation and TCO modeling are definite pluses.
  • Success penetrating and managing a minimum of three major accounts (Fortune 500-1000).
  • Ability to work in an organized, procedural manner using tools such as Salesforce.com to facilitate process and information organization.
  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science/engineering or related and proven technical field experience in IT industry preferred.
  • Sales methodology experience (MEDDIC, TAS, SPIN, Solution Selling, Challenger, etc.)
  • Able to work remotely and autonomously
  • Travel up to 50%
